caption: The video captures a close-up of a moss-covered stone spout protruding from the right, already discharging a continuous clear stream of water that falls into a dark pool below. The falling column holds its position while its surface texture and edges flicker with turbulence, the flow unbroken throughout. At the impact point, a bright patch of white foam shifts shape and intensity, sending scattered bubbles across the pool surface. Concentric ripples spread outward from the splash, and a vertical shimmering reflection of the column wavers and breaks up on the water. A thin secondary sheet of water runs off the top and right of the structure, shimmering slightly as it descends. The spout, the out-of-focus dried straw and earth in the background, and the overall framing hold steady. The discharge continues evenly, the flowing water and disturbed pool surface carrying the visible motion.
relations: Water discharging from the moss-covered stone spout falls continuously into the dark pool below.
The impact of the falling column generates shifting white foam and scattered bubbles on the surface.
Concentric ripples spread outward from the splash, distorting the vertical reflection of the falling water.
A secondary sheet of water runs off the structure while the background and framing hold steady.
